tracks.label: Read
tracks.tagline: The whole method in one sitting.
tracks.intro: The condensed corpus reads end to end in well under an hour: one core document, four templates, a glossary, and the record of the ablation that produced it.

steps.narration: The whole method: the Plan-mode-first posture, the three things the methodology still carries (documentary levels, bidirectional discoverability, values compass), and the three rules worth keeping.
The four surviving templates: vision note, backlog idea, tracer-bullet brief, architecture decision. Copy, fill in, delete sections that do not apply.
Shared vocabulary: document types, naming conventions, status and role vocabulary.
Why the corpus is this small: the before/after record of the 2026-08 radical ablation (roughly 93% reduction).
